name: Is design-build better than hiring a separate architect and contractor?

mainEntity.name: Is design-build better than hiring a separate architect and contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Design-build can speed up coordination because one team handles both design and construction, which may reduce handoff problems. A separate design-bid-build setup can provide more independent bidding and design control, but it may take longer and require tighter coordination.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design-build can be faster and simpler to coordinate, while separate design and construction teams can give more bidding control. The better option depends on your priorities.
